15d0df64ec44: HooBuy Consolidation vs Split Parcels: Decision Guide
e667a5a174c6: PARCEL COMPOSITION · ROUTE ELIGIBILITY · RISK CONTROL
29137f7fb5a4: hoobuys.net is an independent guide and is not HooBuy. HooBuy's public pages describe warehouse storage, item records, packaging, shipping charges and route estimation as parts of its workflow. They do not establish that consolidating every item is always cheaper or that any particular split will be accepted by every route. Use the live parcel interface for current eligibility and amounts.
b2805c9ae93b: Parcel consolidation sounds like a simple choice: put more warehouse items into one box and avoid paying for several shipments. That can work, but it is not a rule. One bulky carton may be billed on dimensions; one restricted item may remove an otherwise useful route; one fragile product may require protection that is awkward beside dense clothing. A split can cost more in repeated minimum charges yet still be the better decision when it protects route choice or separates risk.
